description: This file contains functions related to installing, upgrading, and configuring system email templates in SuiteCRM, including template retrieval and configuration updates.

methods.name: installSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Installs system email templates based on predefined configurations, avoiding duplicates, and writes configuration changes to file.

methods.name: upgradeSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Upgrades system email templates by re-invoking the installation process.

methods.name: setSystemEmailTemplatesDefaultConfig
methods.description: Sets default configuration for system email templates, specifically for confirm opt-in templates, and updates configuration files.

methods.name: getSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined system email templates with subject, body, and HTML content.
